$comment: Whitelisted assets. Every one is enforced on-chain: AegisVault stores this set,
and the SLM's allocation is rejected if it names a symbol outside it.
Each entry must satisfy three independent things or it cannot be traded:
2. a Uniswap V3 pool against WETH that actually quotes (checked per fee tier),
3. a CoinGecko id returning enough OHLC candles for the 21-period windows.
Testnet pool pricing is arbitrary and differs wildly between fee tiers, which is
why uniswapV3.ts quotes every tier and takes the best rather than assuming one.
